description: This is a shell script file for testing a diff highlight tool. It defines test functions, sets up test cases, and runs various assertions to ensure the correctness of diff highlighting features, including handling of Unicode, color, and graph options.

methods.name: dh_test
methods.description: Performs diff highlighting tests by generating diff/commit output with git and comparing the highlighted output against expected output.

methods.name: test_strip_patch_header
methods.description: Removes the header lines starting with '@@' from diff output.

methods.name: dh_test_setup_history
methods.description: Sets up a git repository with a specific commit history to test diff highlighting of complex histories.

methods.name: trim_graph
methods.description: Removes graph symbols from diff output to simplify parsing.
